lobbying_activities.description: H.R. 2670/S. 2226 - National Defense Authorization Act FY24, H.R. 4365/S. 2587 - Department of Defense Appropriations Act FY24 and H.R. 3932/S. 2103 - Intelligence Authorization Act FY24; provisions relating to acquisition policy, aircraft propulsion, force protection, command and control, simulation and training, self-defense systems and decoys, missile defense, sensors and radars, missiles, munitions and artillery, advanced materials and advanced technology programs, thermal management research, novel power systems, naval shipbuilding and systems, system sustainment, avionics, and intelligence matters. H.R. 4820/S.2437 - Transportation, Housing and Urban Development and Related Agencies Appropriations Act FY24; provisions related to air traffic control modernization, satellite voice communications, FAA. H.R. 5893/S. 2321 - Commerce, Justice, Science and Related Agencies Appropriations Act FY24; provisions related to NOAA, NASA. H.R. 4394/S. 2443 - Energy and Water and Related Agencies Appropriations Act FY24; provisions related to propulsion technologies and alternative fuels. H.R. 4665/S. 2438 - Department of State, Foreign Operations, and Related Programs Appropriations Act FY24; provisions related to foreign military assistance. Issues related to supplemental funding for Ukraine (bill pending). P.L. 118-15 - FY24 Continuing Appropriations and Other Extensions Act; monitored all provisions.

Issues associated with Congressional notifications of proposed foreign military and direct commercial sales. Issues related to export control reform and foreign military sales policy. H.R. 4367/S. 2625 - Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act FY24; provisions related to the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency.
